input: raw review text (string); preprocessing is inside the pipeline
dataset: Fake Reviews Dataset (Salminen et al., 2021); Kaggle: mexwell/fake-reviews-dataset. CG = computer-generated (reported GPT-2), OR = original reviews (presumed human)
limitations: Trained on computer-generated vs presumed-human reviews from one dataset; not validated on paid human fake reviews or real marketplaces.
Less accurate on very short reviews.
No product- or reviewer-level generalisation test (dataset has no such IDs).
